narrationTexts: I'll look at the history and changelog.
finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, 3 breaking, 1 feature, 10 fixes.

Three breaking ones hide in `refactor` commits. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. The v1 export route is deleted. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from five modules.

Perf work had no heading. I put it under `Added`. Move it if you want a fourth.

Next: pick a minimum Node version. CI moved to node 22 and `.nvmrc` got pinned. I could not read the value.
